title: Learning Clean Generative Processes from Noisy Measurements
abstract: arXiv:2610.42036v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study how to learn a generative model of clean images using only noisy observations. Diffusion processes and their generalizations to non-Gaussian noise require posterior predictions at every noise level. We first show that it is possible to learn these predictions from independent noisy views using Noise2Noise regression, but only at or above the noise level of the training data. To learn the predictions below that level, needed to generate clean images, we impose consistency: a prediction should equal its expectation after continuing the sampling process. We derive conditions under which consistency uniquely determines the continuation to the clean image distribution and verify them for Poisson, binomial, Gamma, and negative-binomial measurements. translated_title: 从含噪测量中学习干净的生成过程
translated_abstract: 我们研究如何仅利用含噪观测来学习干净图像的生成模型。扩散过程及其向非高斯噪声的推广需要在每个噪声水平上进行后验预测。我们首先证明，可以使用Noise2Noise回归从独立的含噪视图中学习这些预测，但仅限于等于或高于训练数据噪声水平的范围。为了学习低于该水平的预测——这是生成干净图像所必需的——我们引入一致性约束：预测应等于其继续采样过程之后的期望。我们推导出了一致性唯一确定向干净图像分布延续的条件，并在泊松、二项、伽马和负二项测量下验证了这些条件。在CIFAR-10、光子计数显微镜和合成孔径雷达上的实验表明，所需的后验预测可以仅从含噪视图中学习得到，并且一致性（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出结合Noise2Noise回归与一致性约束的方法，使得能够仅从含噪观测中学习到所有噪声水平上的后验预测，从而训练出可生成干净图像的生成模型，并在泊松、二项、伽马、负二项等多种噪声类型及真实数据上验证了其有效性。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that clean-image generative models can be learned purely from noisy measurements by combining Noise2Noise regression with a consistency condition that uniquely determines posterior predictions below the training noise level, validated on Poisson, binomial, Gamma, and negative-binomial measurements across CIFAR-10, photon-counting microscopy, and synthetic aperture radar.
